description: This Java source file defines the class `LoggingConnectionEventProducer` which implements the `ConnectionEventProducer` interface. Its purpose is to log connection and disconnection events with relevant details at INFO level, serving as a logging-only implementation within the Eclipse Hono service monitoring package.
